guide.title: How Udhaar works
guide.subtitle: Two things to remember: your pocket and your notebook
guide.intro: A khata keeps two different things apart. Your pocket holds the real money you have. Your notebook only writes down who owes whom.
guide.ruleSign: On every row, + (green) means money came into your pocket and - means it went out.
guide.ruleCards: The Net, Get and Give cards and the Gave / Got tabs follow your notebook.
guide.ruleForgive: Forgiven (maaf) is the only time no money moves. Only the notebook changes.

effect.diya: You lent money. Your pocket goes down, but the notebook now says your friend owes you.
effect.liya: You borrowed money. Your pocket goes up, but the notebook now says you owe your friend.
effect.diya_wapis_liya: Your friend paid you back. Your pocket goes up and the notebook is cleared.
effect.liya_wapis_diya: You paid your friend back. Your pocket goes down and the notebook is cleared.
effect.diya_maaf: You forgave what your friend owed you. Your pocket stays the same and the notebook is cleared.
effect.liya_maaf: Your friend forgave what you owed. Your pocket stays the same and the notebook is cleared.
